info.name: Smart Library - Microservices (via API Gateway)
info.description: Set `baseUrl` to the gateway (http://<EC2-1 public IP>:8000 or http://localhost:8000) and `adminKey` to ADMIN_REGISTRATION_KEY, then run the folders in order (right-click collection -> Run). Tokens and ids are stored automatically.

request.description: Shows whether each of the 8 downstream services is reachable from the gateway.
Public. 201 the first time, 409 if the email already exists.
Set the collection variable adminKey = ADMIN_REGISTRATION_KEY.
Sets the same password again so the collection stays re-runnable.
